name: FindA.Sale
description: Discover estate sales, yard sales, auctions, flea markets, and consignment sales. Search by location, date, and type. Browse items for sale across all active listings.

tools.name: search_sales
tools.description: Search for active sales by city, location, date range, or sale type

tools.name: get_sale
tools.description: Get full details for a specific sale including items, organizer, and schedule

tools.name: search_items
tools.description: Search for items for sale across all active FindA.Sale listings

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Get details for a specific item including price, condition, and photos

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List cities and metro areas where FindA.Sale has active listings

tools.name: list_sale_types

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List item categories available across FindA.Sale listings
